notes.title: Demo Patch #1.9
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In response to NextFest feedback, a few additions and changes have been made to the Demo.

[list]
[*] A new solution to retrieving the Ice Cream has been added.
[*] Two new hidden tonics have been added. 
[*] You can now properly store your weapons in the cloakroom in order to lower your Base Suspicion.
[*] A version overlay has been added to more easily identify bugs seen in gameplay footage from players.[/list]
[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]
[list][*] Fixed the Desk Clerk's insatiable desire to greet you.
[*] Made music changes smoother.
[*] Made some AI responses smoother.
[*] Fixed the cursor not removing properly when walking away to end a conversation.[/list]

Further changes, improvements and additions are to come down the road.

Please report any issues to: support@riskmaster-studios.com

Or to keep up to date with development or more easily report bugs, please join our discord server [url=https://discord.gg/BcrFhC2zUg]here[/url].

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone,

In preparation for Steam Next Fest, I have made a number of fixes and changes to the Demo.

[u][b]Quest Log[/b][/u]

A Quest Log (L by default) has been added to give clearer direction to Players, though not fully handholding towards the solution to each objective. 

[b][u]Sprinting Removed[/u][/b]

Sprinting was causing numerous issues with the game, namely making it too easy, so has been removed. It may be restored in the future based on Player feedback and further testing.

[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]

[list][*] Fixed a few spelling errors.
[*] Increased Club Card hitbox size to make it easier to pick up.
[*] Fixed Tutorial Guide text not saving properly.
[*] Made Tutorial Auto-Saves conditional to avoid confusion.
[*] Fixed Cutscene camera angles that broke due to trying to fix them before.
[*] Fixed some Saving bugs
[*] Changed the Deduction UI background.[/list]

I intend to patch the game further before Steam Next Fest begins next month.

Please report any issues to: support@riskmaster-studios.com

Or to keep up to date with development or more easily report bugs, please join our discord server [url=https://discord.gg/BcrFhC2zUg]here[/url].
